_comment: Project-scope MCP servers for the ops tier. Copy to agent/ops-agent/.mcp.json (gitignored, so your copy never conflicts with an update) and add the servers your own jobs need. The ops tier is the only one that loads chrome-devtools (the automation Chrome on :9222); ops-light and ops-haiku ship their own Chrome-less .mcp.json. No secrets here: ${VAR} placeholders are expanded from the environment, which process-manager.mjs loads from .env.
